references.name: historic-main-facade
references.author: A.Savin, Wikipedia
references.observed: Ordinary 2010 main-front photograph inspected: pale carved trim on grey-brown lower masonry, turquoise ceramic upper frieze, asymmetrical tall narrow left spire, broad eastern tented/flared roof with ornate ridge crest and small dormers, rounded flanking entrance piers, right square turret/steep roof, tall glazed central opening and large arched lower entrance, repeated ground arches and rectangular upper windows. No copied lettering, symbols, cars, overhead wires, brands or people.

references.name: station-platforms-2026
references.author: Sergey A. Demidov
references.observed: Ordinary February 2026 yard photograph inspected: long open paved platforms with concrete edges and exposed tracks/catenary. The background station/yard service buildings do not establish hidden passenger-terminal facade inventory. No copied train, snow layer, people or overhead wire inventory.
